==Overview ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He can only be obtained by evolving [[Griffin]]. 

{{EvolutionTable}}
{{Takedowns|7,500}}

Additionally, he requires either 200 Eggs of Sacrifice or 24 {{Rarity|Mythical}} or 12 evolved {{Rarity|Mythical}}  units. 

==Stats Overview==

|caption1="Among thousands of comrades and ten thousand enemies, you're the only one who made me forget my dream. I... sacrifice."

==Sacrifice==
<tabber>
|-|Griffin (Reincarnation)=
*[[Griffin (Reincarnation)]]​ -​ Sacrificed BUFF Types 
** Note that not all support units can be used for this variant. Unsellable units cannot be used for sacrifice. (e.g Idol and Idol (Idol) ).
**The percentage will show up in <font color="yellow">Yellow</font> if the unit was a BUFF type.
**The reincarnation variant's buff can be stacked with [[Blossom]], [[Idol (Star)]],  [[Commander]], [[Wenda]], and [[Elfy (Sylph)]]  buff.
**The reincarnation variant's buff stacks additively with all other buffs.
**The reincarnation variant needs a minimum of 100,000¥ to summon.

|-|Griffin (Darkness)=
* [[Griffin (Darkness)]]​ -​ Sacrifice non-BUFF Types
** The percentage will show up in <font color="red">Red</font> if the unit was a DAMAGE type.
** The darkness variant needs a minimum of 100,000¥ so 1 maxed out [[Hubris (The One)]] (without [[Idol (Star)]]) can summon instantly.
** The darkness variant's damage can be increased above the 100% threshold, the increase in dmg per !% extra is unknown currently due to the fact that it increases then at some specific percentage begins to decrease.
</tabber>

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost, However [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] cannot be sold.

==Trivia==
*Shiny Griffin appears as [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] in the lobby, instead of [[Griffin (Darkness)]] like normal.
*Before Update 17, the reincarnation variant costed a minimum of 30,000¥ to summon, and it used to stack multiplicatively with [[Commander]], [[Wind Dragon]], and [[Elfy (Sylph)]] buffs. This has since been increased to 100,000¥, and his buff now stacks additively to all other damage buffs.
